ruleset.name: GeoPulse
ruleset.description: Blocking rules only: every rule here either guards the API error contract or catches a real bug. Rules are listed one by one (no whole-category imports) so a PMD upgrade cannot add rules silently. Suppress a deliberate case with a reasoned "// NOPMD - why" comment; UnnecessaryWarningSuppression reports suppressions that no longer match anything.

rule.name: NoTransportExceptionsOutsideHttpBoundaries
rule.message: Application code must throw GeoPulseException, not HttpProblem or JAX-RS transport exceptions.

rule.name: NoBroadGeoPulseTranslationCatch
rule.message: A broad catch can swallow an already classified GeoPulseException; narrow the try or catch type.

property.name: xpath

rule.name: NoManualErrorResponses
rule.message: Hand-built 4xx/5xx responses bypass the problem+json contract; throw GeoPulseException instead.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[ ( pmd-java:matchesSig('jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response#serverError()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.jboss.resteasy.reactive.RestResponse#notFound()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.jboss.resteasy.reactive.RestResponse#serverError()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.jboss.resteasy.reactive.RestResponse$ResponseBuilder#notFound()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('org.jboss.resteasy.reactive.RestResponse$ResponseBuilder#serverError()') or ( @MethodName = 'status' and ArgumentList/*[1][ self::NumericLiteral[@ValueAsInt >= 400] or self::FieldAccess[@Name = ( 'BAD_REQUEST', 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'PAYMENT_REQUIRED', 'FORBIDDEN', 'NOT_FOUND', 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED', 'NOT_ACCEPTABLE', 'PROXY_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED', 'REQUEST_TIMEOUT', 'CONFLICT', 'GONE', 'LENGTH_REQUIRED', 'PRECONDITION_FAILED', 'REQUEST_ENTITY_TOO_LARGE', 'REQUEST_URI_TOO_LONG', 'UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE', 'REQUESTED_RANGE_NOT_SATISFIABLE', 'EXPECTATION_FAILED', 'PRECONDITION_REQUIRED', 'TOO_MANY_REQUESTS', 'REQUEST_HEADER_FIELDS_TOO_LARGE', 'UNAVAILABLE_FOR_LEGAL_REASONS', 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR', 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED', 'BAD_GATEWAY', 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', 'GATEWAY_TIMEOUT', 'HTTP_VERSION_NOT_SUPPORTED', 'NETWORK_AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED')] ] ) ) and not(ancestor::ClassDeclaration[ @SimpleName = ('DemoModeWriteGuardFilter', 'BackupRestoreGuardFilter') ]) ]

rule.name: NoSystemDefaultTimeZone
rule.message: Do not depend on the server time zone; pass the user zone (or ZoneOffset.UTC) explicitly.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodCall[ pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.ZoneId#systemDefault()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.Clock#systemDefaultZone()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.TimeZone#getDefault()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.util.Calendar#getInstance()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.LocalDate#now()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.LocalDateTime#now()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.LocalTime#now()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.ZonedDateTime#now()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.OffsetDateTime#now()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.YearMonth#now()') or pmd-java:matchesSig('java.time.Year#now()') ]
